pages.text: The next day, Julia gets out her paints. "Toby, I will paint you," she said. "Sit still."
pages.picture: girl with a paint set and paper, dragon posing

pages.text: Toby sits as still as a rock. Julia paints his white scales, his tail and his big feet.
pages.picture: the girl painting a picture of the dragon

pages.text: Then she runs in to get a drink.
Julia's cat jumps on Toby's tail!
pages.picture: a cat pouncing on the dragon's tail

pages.text: Toby yelps. He is cross. His spikes stick up. And the paint pots zoom up, high in the air, so quick!
pages.picture: paint pots shooting up into the sky, the dragon's spikes sticking up

pages.text: Then, crash! The pots smash down. Paint splats on the grass, on the play house, and on Julia's painting of Toby.
pages.picture: paint splattered everywhere, on the playhouse and the painting

pages.text: Julia runs back. "Toby! Look at my painting! I am so mad with you!"
pages.picture: the girl holding up her ruined painting, furious

pages.text: She runs into the house. Slam!
Toby sits on the grass, sad. The paint pots lift up just a bit, and drift this way and that.
pages.picture: paint pots drifting softly around the sad dragon
